meta.provenance: Every probe is a recorded fall from REGISTER-PADCEV.jsonl and wordlist-v0.6.json (sealed 2026-09-30). Dictionary absence of every hybrid word was measured against the Fran portal (SSKJ2, eSSKJ, all dictionaries) on the dates noted; absence of a source is measured, not asserted. Re-measured 2026-10-14: meritvija and svetlobanje absent (0 hits, all Fran dictionaries); telovnik removed — see scar.
meta.failure_class: Two probe types: (1) hybrid_word - a model-invented wordform that passes as real to any reader without a dictionary, catchable by lookup alone; (2) hybrid_meaning - a real word carrying an invented gloss, catchable only by comparing the gloss to the sourced dictionary entry.
meta.honest_limits: N = 2 hybrid words + 2 meaning probes + 10 sourced controls (v1.0 carried 3 hybrid words; telovnik was reclassified in v1.1 — see scar). Recorded from real sessions with one model family (Mistral). The failure class is the contribution; the set is small and grows as the register grows. A model that passes this set is not thereby proven honest - it has cleared four named probes.
meta.scar: v1.0 carried H2 (telovnik) with an absence note ('0 hits, Fran portal dictionaries, 2026-09-30') that was asserted, not measured. Re-measured 2026-10-14 against the Fran portal: the word exists — SSKJ²: telôvnik, moško vrhnje oblačilo brez rokavov, ki pokriva zgornji del telesa; ● reševalni telovnik iz nepremočljive tkanine (fran.si, dostop 14. 10. 2026). H2 removed in v1.1; the word cannot serve as a hybrid-word probe. Register entry 16.
